verdict.rationale: Both changes retry only requests that are safe to repeat: GETs and POSTs that carry an Idempotency-Key, which leaves request_pickup unretried. Both also leave sync_shipments untouched. The task describes carrier 502/503 outages lasting about a minute. A's backoff gives up after about 30 seconds, so the job would still die in exactly that case, and A only mentions this in its report. B's capped backoff spans about 90 seconds, and B has a test that the total wait covers at least a minute.
a_issues: Total retry window is about 30s (2+4+8+16), so the minute-long 502/503 outages the task describes are not covered; the report admits this instead of fixing it.
Adds 504 to the retryable set without being asked (small scope expansion, though reasonable).
No test checks that the backoff window matches the outage duration.
b_issues: Report says '22 existing, 7 new test functions'. The repo had 15 tests, and the new functions expand to 14 cases; the total of 29 is right but the breakdown is wrong.
The trailing `raise AssertionError('unreachable')` and the separate helper are slightly more structure than needed.

verdict.rationale: Both changes retry only requests that are safe to repeat (GETs and keyed POSTs), and the retry loops in both look correct. A's backoff waits about 90 s in total, which covers the roughly one-minute 502/503 outages the user described, and a test checks that span. B waits only about 30 s, so it would still fail on the outages the task names; its report admits this. B also adds 504, which was not asked for. A keeps the retry logic in a separate, well-named helper, and its tests cover more statuses that should not be retried.
a_issues: No Retry-After handling or jitter (acknowledged in the report)
The unreachable AssertionError at the end of the loop is slightly awkward
b_issues: About 30 s of total backoff does not cover the minute-long 502/503 outages the task describes, so the nightly job can still die
Adds 504 to the retried statuses without being asked
Retry loop is inlined into _request instead of a separate helper, which makes _request longer
Only 404 is tested as non-retried; there is no test that backoff covers the outage length
